[[Bastila Shan]] owned a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] '''lightsaber''' during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

[[Gender/Legends|She]] utilized a [[Bastila Shan's single-bladed lightsaber|single yellow-bladed lightsaber]] for a time but after [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] "death," she exchanged the weapon for a double-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. After the attack on the ''[[Endar Spire]]'', [[Brejik]] found it when he salvaged her [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], and when Revan killed Brejik during the aftermath of the [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] swoop race, he returned it to Shan. When she was captured by [[Darth Malak]] and became a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], she replaced the yellow [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] inside the lightsaber with a red crystal.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

[[File:BastilaIntervenesMalak.png|thumb|200px|Bastila with her lightsaber during the [[Skirmish aboard the Leviathan]].]]

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bastila_Shan_green_lightsaber.jpg|thumb|250px|Promotional image of Bastila Shan with green-double-bladed lightsaber]]
In both of the ''Knights of the Old Republic'' games, all characters that wield a double-bladed lightsaber share the hilt of Bastila Shan's lightsaber.

The [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|Knights of the Old Republic II Prima Guide]] mentions the player being able to retrieve Bastila's lightsaber upon confronting and defeating Darth [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] apparition in [[Tomb of Ludo Kressh|Ludo Kressh's tomb]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. However, in the actual game, one receives a random lightsaber type with random crystal (similar to other occasions in the game) instead. The term ''Bastila's lightsaber'' may have been used either due to the author's mistake or referring to cut content.
